counting_rule: Every START consumes one process, one inference call, and the cell's only attempt.
binding_rule: FINISH hashes complete captured stdout/stderr; valid stdout must reparse under the sole structured_output rule to byte-identical canonical RAW, including response presence/type and string length/hash metadata. The complete stdout capture hash preserves all ignored response bytes as the trust root.
finish_guarantee: Every spawned attempt appends FINISH, including process, parse, capture, or post-spawn exceptions.
